name: zsnd_cd_init
description: zSndCd::Init opens and probes the MCI CD-audio device, caches disc and AUX mixer state, resets CD playback state, and builds the configured CD track list.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The native smoke patches WinMM MCI/AUX providers instead of requiring a real CD-audio device.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a20d0 validates the ready-flag guard, MCI_OPEN of cdaudio, status item 5 media gate, MCI_SET time format 10, status item 3 track-count cache, status item 1 packed TMSF disc-length cache, AUX device scan for CD-audio volume/LR-volume support, aux volume cache, ResetTrackState call, ready-flag set, and optional CD_TRACKS array walk.
Binary Ninja assembly notes document the decompiler's stack-slot alias limitation in the final list insertion: assembly stores the zSndCdTrackEntry pointer saved at [esp+0x10] into trackNode->entry.

Native smokes verify the ready guard and a patched provider success path covering the MCI command order, AUX scan and volume cache, disc length and track count globals, reset playback state, and two configured CD track entries appended to the global sentinel list.
